1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SmallPolyhedronUniqueRouteCutVertex
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.UniqueRouteLeaves
3 
4 /-! Original nonsource vertices are leaves for a cofacial source on a
5 small polyhedron. In particular, this applies to a universal vertex.
6 The conclusion supplies the original-leaf field of the star charts;
7 it does not assume that field as a geometric input. -/
8 
9 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
10 
11 open Set
12 
13 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (size : P.vertices.card ≤ 6)
14   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
15     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
16 
17 include size small_faces in
18 /-- A cut-tree vertex reached by a unique shortest route has exactly one neighbor. -/
19 theorem small_unique_route_cut_vertex_is_leaf (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
20     (u : T.vertices) (unique : (P.geodesicFiber a (T.vertexTarget u)).Subsingleton) :
21     ∃! v, T.graph.Adj u v := by
22   letI : Nontrivial T.vertices := T.toEmbeddedCutGraph.vertices_nontrivial
23   obtain ⟨v, edge⟩ := T.tree.connected.preconnected.exists_adj_of_nontrivial u
24   exact ⟨v, edge, fun w other =>
25     small_unique_route_cut_vertex_at_most_one_neighbor size small_faces a T u unique w v other edge⟩
26 
27 include size small_faces in
28 /-- Every original cut vertex is a leaf when the source shares a face with every vertex. -/
29 theorem small_cofacial_source_original_is_leaf (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
30     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val)
31     (u : T.vertices) (original : (u : Space) ∈ P.vertices) :
32     ∃! v, T.graph.Adj u v := by
33   obtain ⟨F, source, target⟩ := cofacial ⟨u, original⟩
34   exact small_unique_route_cut_vertex_is_leaf size small_faces a T u
35     (P.geodesicFiber_cofacial_unique a (T.vertexTarget u) F source target)
36 
37 include size small_faces in
38 /-- An internal passage between different tree edges avoids all original vertices. -/
39 theorem small_cofacial_source_internal_vertex_nonvertex
40     (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
41     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val)
42     (u v w : T.vertices) (first : T.graph.Adj u v) (second : T.graph.Adj u w)
43     (different : v ≠ w) : (u : Space) ∉ P.vertices := by
44   intro original
45   obtain ⟨only, _, unique⟩ := small_cofacial_source_original_is_leaf size small_faces a T cofacial u original
46   exact different ((unique v first).trans (unique w second).symm)
47 
48 /-- A universal vertex shares an original face with every vertex, including itself. -/
49 theorem universal_source_cofacial (a : frontier P.body) (source : P.Vertex)
50     (at_source : (a : Space) = (source : Space))
51     (universal : ∀ v : P.Vertex, v ≠ source → P.edgeGraph.Adj source v) :
52     ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val := by
53   intro v
54   by_cases same : v = source
55   · obtain ⟨w, original, different⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_ne
56       (show 1 < P.vertices.card by have := P.four_le_vertex_count; omega) (source : Space)
57     have distinct : (⟨w, original⟩ : P.Vertex) ≠ source :=
58       fun equal => different (congrArg Subtype.val equal)
59     obtain ⟨_, F, G, _, edge⟩ := universal ⟨w, original⟩ distinct
60     have inside : (source : Space) ∈ F.val ∩ G.val := by
61       rw [edge]
62       exact left_mem_segment ℝ _ _
63     exact ⟨F, by simpa only [at_source] using inside.1, by simpa only [same] using inside.1⟩
64   · obtain ⟨_, F, G, _, edge⟩ := universal v same
65     have first : (source : Space) ∈ F.val ∩ G.val := by
66       rw [edge]
67       exact left_mem_segment ℝ _ _
68     have last : (v : Space) ∈ F.val ∩ G.val := by
69       rw [edge]
70       exact right_mem_segment ℝ _ _
71     exact ⟨F, by simpa only [at_source] using first.1, last.1⟩
72 
73 include size small_faces in
74 /-- Universal sources supply the original-leaf condition required by the star construction. -/
75 theorem small_universal_source_original_is_leaf
76     (a : frontier P.body) (source : P.Vertex) (at_source : (a : Space) = (source : Space))
77     (universal : ∀ v : P.Vertex, v ≠ source → P.edgeGraph.Adj source v)
78     (T : P.CutLocusTree a) (u : T.vertices) (original : (u : Space) ∈ P.vertices) :
79     ∃! v, T.graph.Adj u v :=
80   small_cofacial_source_original_is_leaf size small_faces a T
81     (universal_source_cofacial a source at_source universal) u original
82 
83 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
